exposure: Loss of retroplacental T2 hypointense line
Partial placental volume of lower uterine segment (PV(partial))
cohort: The study included 148 consecutive patients with placental malposition who underwent MRI and cesarean section at the study hospital.
finding: Partial placental volume of the lower uterine segment (PV(partial)) was identified as an accurate and objective indicator with the highest area under the curve (0.81) for diagnosing massive hemorrhage during cesarean section.
